milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The player must navigate near the gray glazed terracotta pillar (centered at spawn-relative [3.5, 1, 4]) and face toward it, confirming they have visually located the landmark. max_distance=16 and facing_tolerance=60 model 'player can see the target'.

Uses count_in_box_at_most (kind='block', max_count=0) because glass panes do NOT drop as items when broken without Silk Touch. The wooden pickaxe has no Silk Touch, so inventory_has would never trigger. Instead, we verify the lime_stained_glass_pane blocks have been removed from their placed positions (spawn-relative ~7-8, ~1, ~3). Box is generous: x=5-10, y=0-3, z=1-5 to account for any coordinate variance.

Uses inventory_has because crafted cobblestone_slabs end up in the player's inventory. The recipe is 3 cobblestone in a row → 6 cobblestone_slabs. The scene provides exactly 3 cobblestone blocks inside the enclosed room, so one successful craft yields 6 slabs. min_count=6 confirms the player completed the craft.
